# s4communication_outbound_user (List Resource)

Lists the outbound users of communication systems. Use with `terraform query`, optionally with `-generate-config-out` to write configuration with import blocks. Passwords are never returned by SAP.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List the outbound users of all communication systems
list "s4communication_outbound_user" "all" {
  provider = s4communication
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `communication_system_uuid` (String) Only list the outbound users of the communication system with this UUID.
